apis.summary: — List tasks with operator projection (no book fields).
apis.details: Permission field.task.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 403 FIELD-AUTH-403-SCOPE: site not in scope Request GET /v1/tasks?site_id=0192...&type=count&limit=50 Response {"items":[{"id":"0192f...","type":"count","erp_ref":"100000012/2026","lines":[{"id":"...","bin":"03-05-02","material":"MAT-1001","uom":"EA"}]}],"next_cursor":null}

apis.summary: — Trigger an immediate delivery poll for a site.
apis.details: Permission field.integration or field.supervisor Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 100 ms (async) Errors 409 FIELD-IMP-409-RUNNING: a sync is already running Request {"site_id":"0192...","since":"2026-11-20T00:00:00Z"} Response {"job_id":"0192...","status":"queued"}

apis.summary: — Upload SAP delivery CSV; returns preview with match ladder results.
apis.details: Permission field.integration Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 2 s for 1,000 rows Errors 422 FIELD-IMP-422-MAPPING: required column missing 422 FIELD-IDEM-422-BODY: same key different body Request multipart: file=deliveries.csv, mapping={...} Response {"import_id":"...","rows":40,"auto_accepted":36,"review":4,"errors":0}

Permission field.capture.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms Errors 422 FIELD-VOICE-422-CONFIDENCE: confidence < 0.80 409 FIELD-TASK-409-STATE: line already posted Request {"qty":30,"uom":"EA","voice_event_id":"...","confidence":0.91} Response {"line_id":"...","counted_qty":30,"source":"voice","version":7}

Permission field.capture.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms Errors 422 FIELD-RCV-422-EVIDENCE: photo required Request {"flag":"damaged","capture_id":"...","evidence_id":"..."} Response {"line_id":"...","damaged_qty":12,"status":"in_progress"}

apis.summary: — Confirm staged lines; creates erp_document and posting jobs.
apis.details: Permission field.post.confirm Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 409 FIELD-RCV-409-OVER-TOLERANCE: supervisor decision needed 422 FIELD-RCV-422-REASON: reason code missing 423 FIELD-PI-423-POSTING-BLOCKED: bin under count Request Idempotency-Key: 0192f3a0-7c1e-7b2a-9d1e-1f2a3b4c5d6e {"stage_id":"...","lines":["..."]} Response {"erp_document_id":"...","queue_key":"IBD:180000123","jobs":3,"status":"queued"}

Permission field.post.confirm (own, window) or field.supervisor Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 409 FIELD-ERP-409-ALREADY-REVERSED 409 FIELD-ERP-409-NOT-POSTED Request Idempotency-Key: ... {"items":["000010"],"reason":"wrong_material"} Response {"erp_document_id":"...","doc_type":"GR_REV","status":"queued"}

Permission field.post.confirm Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 422 FIELD-PUT-422-REASON: different bin needs reason 409 FIELD-PUT-409-HOLD-ZONE Request {"scanned_bin":"03-05-03","reason":"proposed_bin_full"} Response {"hu_id":"...","bin":"03-05-03","status":"stored"}

apis.summary: — Create/scan an outbound HU and pack quantities.
apis.details: Permission field.capture.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 409 FIELD-PACK-409-EXCEEDS-PICKED 409 FIELD-RCV-409-SSCC-DUPLICATE Request {"sscc":null,"generate":true,"lines":[{"line_id":"...","qty":12}]} Response {"hu_id":"...","sscc":"008901230000000205","packed":[{"line_id":"...","packed_qty":12}]}

Permission field.pi.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 300 ms Errors 422 FIELD-PI-422-TOO-MANY-ITEMS: > FIELD_PI_MAX_ITEMS Request {"site_id":"...","plant":"1000","storage_location":"0001","bins":["03-05-*"],"planned_count_date":"2026-11-27","freeze":true,"posting_block":true} Response {"id":"...","status":"draft","items":42,"queue_key":"PID:pending"}

Permission field.capture.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 409 FIELD-PI-409-RECOUNT-SAME-OPERATOR 409 FIELD-PI-409-NOT-ASSIGNED Request Idempotency-Key: ... {"qty":48,"is_zero":false,"source":"mixed","capture_ids":["..."]} Response {"item":"...","count_no":1,"status":"committed"} // never contains book_qty, difference or recount reason

apis.summary: — Request difference posting; returns approval need.
apis.details: Permission field.pi.post Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 200 ms Errors 409 FIELD-PI-409-OPEN-RECOUNTS 403 FIELD-APR-403-SOD: approver excluded 401 FIELD-APR-401-REAUTH: re-authentication older than 300 s Request Idempotency-Key: ... {} Response {"status":"awaiting_approval","approval_request_id":"...","band":"B2","value_abs":"72000.00","currency":"INR"}

apis.summary: — Retry now a failed or waiting job (also /cancel).
apis.details: Permission field.queue.manage Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 100 ms Errors 409 FIELD-Q-409-NOT-HEAD: only the head job can be retried Request {"reason":"SAP lock released"} Response {"id":"...","state":"pending","next_attempt_at":"2026-11-24T09:12:00Z"}

apis.summary: — Save graph draft; POST .../graph/publish publishes it.
apis.details: Permission field.graph.edit Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 800 ms for 20k nodes Errors 412 FIELD-GRAPH-412-ETAG 422 FIELD-GRAPH-422-CYCLE: location hierarchy cycle Request If-Match: "v12-draft-3" {"nodes":[...],"edges":[...],"anchors":[...]} Response {"version":13,"status":"draft","problems":[{"code":"BIN_NO_NODE","ref":"03-05-02"}]}

Permission field.task.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 80 ms Errors 404 FIELD-GRAPH-404-NO-ROUTE Request GET /v1/sites/.../routes?from_node=n1&to_location=03-05-02 Response {"graph_version":13,"length_m":38.5,"steps":[{"text":"Walk 12 m along Aisle 03","cue":"Look for yellow column C7","node":"..."}]}

Permission field.capture.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms Errors 409 FIELD-TRAIL-409-TASK-INACTIVE Request {"task_id":"...","points":[{"t":"2026-11-24T09:00:01Z","x":12.1,"y":4.0,"floor":0,"acc":0.4,"src":"uwb"}]} Response {"accepted":60}

apis.summary: — Create guided-load export for a site and date range (GET lists files).
apis.details: Permission field.export.run Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 30 s for 100k rows Errors 409 FIELD-EXP-409-RUNNING Request {"site_id":"...","from":"2026-11-23","to":"2026-11-23"} Response {"export_id":"...","file":"field_supply_S001_20261123.csv","rows":214}

apis.summary: — Phase 2 live channel topics for warehouse.
apis.details: Permission field.task.read (+field.queue.manage for queue) Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO update fan-out p95 <= 2 s Errors 4403 not permitted topic Request {"op":"subscribe","topics":["taskboard.0192..."]} Response {"topic":"taskboard.0192...","type":"task.updated","data":{"task_id":"...","progress":"3/12"}}
